subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-off Feishu `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing once the branch is rebased and real Feishu proof is supplied?
rationale: Source inspection shows the missing capability, but adding a new operator-facing Feishu config key and accepting the live proof bar for delivery timing are maintainer product/API choices.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
options.body: Review this PR or a replacement toward per-account/per-target Feishu pacing after it is rebased and backed by redacted real Feishu proof.

options.title: Keep Only Reactive Retry
options.body: Reject the new config surface and document that OpenClaw relies on existing Feishu retry/backoff after rate-limit responses.

options.title: Move Scope To Broad Limiter
options.body: Defer Feishu-specific pacing and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13615 own cross-provider queueing or rate-limit policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
recommendation.body: Review this PR or a replacement toward per-account/per-target Feishu pacing after it is rebased and backed by redacted real Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained owner candidate for Feishu-owned send behavior.
